name: toast
behavior: APG alert pattern (role=alert for warning/critical, role=status for info/success; injected without moving focus; announced by assistive tech; hover pauses auto-dismiss; dismiss control keyboard reachable)

parts.note: themes may value the root recipe on inverse-surface/on-inverse-surface instead (inverted style, per elevation-strategy) — declared in the theme adapter, anatomy unchanged. Tone axis adds a status accent: status-<tone>-border on the leading edge (Salt) or full border.
tone axis swaps the role and color: info → info, success → success, warning → warning, critical → error; colored status-<tone>
hosts a ghost or link prominence button (anatomy/button.json)
